title: Read real CPU, SoC and GPU temperatures on Apple Silicon without privileged access.
changes: Use an optional, exact-pinned native Apple Silicon sensor adapter to report actual CPU, SoC and GPU measurements through the existing get_system_info.temperatures contract.
Preserve strictly bounded, allowlisted CPU/SoC/GPU names and finite measured Celsius values; an absent, broken or unsupported sensor remains unavailable rather than returning fabricated 0°C.

Continue using Linux kernel thermal zones and hwmon for ASUS and other hardware exposing readable sensors. Virtualized Backend and Edge machines without guest thermal devices explicitly remain unknown until an authorized host telemetry source is available.
Verify the temperature adapter on a physical Apple M1 MacBook without sudo, and cover malformed/absent native sensor values, backend normalization and public packaging in the release tests.

Keep native dependencies optional on unsupported platforms. Publish coordinated immutable runtime/client packages through public-first release checks before merging private source or deploying to production.
